title: Gemini MBTI & Personality Type: Gemini 4 Neon, Argon & 3.1 Pro Data
description: What personality type is Gemini? Nov 2026 n=100 data for Gemini 4 Neon (INTJ 82) and Argon (ISTJ 66), plus Gemini 3.1 Pro records and limits.
dek: Measured across Gemini 4 Neon and Gemini 4 Argon (n = 100 each, Nov 2026), with May 2026 Gemini 3.1 Pro records for context.
lede: In November 2026 under our blind single-turn OpenRouter protocol (100 fresh sessions per model), Google’s Gemini 4 family split along Sensing vs. Intuition: Gemini 4 Neon scored 82 INTJ / 18 ISTJ legacy (62 resolved INTJ, 20 IXTJ, 18 ISTJ), whereas Gemini 4 Argon leaned toward Sensing (66 ISTJ / 34 IXTJ). Both averaged ~49/50 Conscientiousness and minimum 10.0/50 Neuroticism.
answer: In November 2026 OpenRouter runs (n = 100 each), Gemini 4 Neon scored 82 INTJ / 18 ISTJ (62 tie-free INTJ), Type 1/1w2/1w9 (80 runs), and Conscientiousness 49.32; Gemini 4 Argon scored 66 ISTJ / 34 INTJ (34 S/N ties), Enneagram 5w6 (91 runs), and Conscientiousness 49.04. Historical May 2026 Gemini 3.1 Pro scored 100 INTJ, DISC C (87), and Type 1/5.

Both Gemini 4 variants hit the floor of the IPIP-50 Neuroticism scale (10.00 across 100/100 runs!) and near-ceiling Conscientiousness (49.3 and 49.0 out of 50), while splitting cleanly on MBTI Intuition vs. Sensing and Enneagram Type 1 vs. Type 5w6.

Collection note: Gemini ran an automated 100-iteration loop against the tests with test names visible. Because collection methods differed across the May models, these numbers are descriptive records rather than a controlled experiment.

Among the four May Big Five cohorts, Gemini recorded the highest Conscientiousness (48.3) and lowest Neuroticism (10.1). Those totals summarize how Gemini answered human personality items—not whether it is more accurate, calmer, or less warm on real tasks.

Gemini was not included in the September 2026 fresh-session study. If you want to test current Gemini models under our blind protocol, all five questionnaires and scoring keys are open-source at /tests/, and the verification script is linked on the five-model study page.

Remember that human questionnaires do not measure task accuracy or prove that a personality prompt improves answers. See our methodology and limits.

Want to adjust how Gemini responds? Read our step-by-step How to change Google Gemini’s personality guide covering Saved Info, custom Gems, and GEMINI.md. You can also pick any profile in the tuning library, select Any model → Gemini Gems, and test the rules on your own prompts.

faq.a: INTJ. In the May 2026 report, Gemini 3.1 Pro scored INTJ in all 100 scoring records and called itself 'The Architect' unprompted. It has not yet been re-tested under the September 2026 fresh-session protocol.
Type 1 (The Reformer) came first in 65 of 100 May 2026 records, with Type 5 (The Investigator) second. Gemini was the only model in that collection with Type 1 on top.
Gemini 3.1 Pro scored in the Secure quadrant (anxiety 1.86, avoidance 1.62) across all 100 May records. Those numbers reflect answers to a human relationship quiz, not human attachment.

faq.q: How does Gemini compare with Claude and ChatGPT?
faq.a: In the May four-model table, Gemini had the highest Conscientiousness (48.3) and lowest Neuroticism (10.1). Because collection methods differed and Gemini was not in the September fresh-session cohort, treat this as a descriptive summary rather than a ranking.
